response.rationale: Temporal association with ipilimumab plus classic dermatomyositis skin and muscle findings (Gottron papules, nailfold changes, proximal weakness, elevated CK) strongly favor ipilimumab-induced dermatomyositis. R1 lacks the drug trigger; R2, R4, R5 miss key features.

rejected.why: Dermatomyositis without specifying ipilimumab induction, less specific to the temporal context.
Only ANA positivity, lacks characteristic skin and muscle findings.
Polymyositis lacks the distinctive cutaneous manifestations.
Dermatitis alone does not explain myositis and elevated muscle enzymes.
